description: This Java class defines the ModifyResource command, which modifies a Resource within a PolicyEntry in the Eclipse Ditto framework. It includes methods for creating instances, parsing from JSON, and retrieving command details.

classes.name: ModifyResource
classes.description: A command class that modifies a Resource within a PolicyEntry, including JSON serialization/deserialization, and command metadata.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a ModifyResource command instance from PolicyId, Label, Resource, and headers.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Creates a ModifyResource command instance from a JSON string or object.

methods.name: getLabel
methods.description: Returns the Label of the PolicyEntry to modify.

methods.name: getResource
methods.description: Returns the Resource to be modified.

methods.name: getEntityId
methods.description: Returns the PolicyId of the Policy to which the Resource belongs.

methods.name: getEntity
methods.description: Returns the JSON representation of the Resource.

methods.name: getResourcePath
methods.description: Returns the JSON pointer path to the Resource within the command payload.

methods.name: appendPayload
methods.description: Appends command data to a JSON object builder, respecting schema version and predicate.

methods.name: getCategory
methods.description: Returns the category of the command, which is MODIFY.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new ModifyResource command with updated DittoHeaders.

methods.name: canEqual
methods.description: Checks if another object is an instance of ModifyResource for equality.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks equality with another object based on policyId, label, resource, and superclass.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Computes hash code based on policyId, label, resource, and superclass.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the ModifyResource object.
